name: Rankioz SEO
author: nemanjatanaskovic

sections.description:
Rankioz SEO is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to bulk-apply SEO meta title and description fixes from Rankioz CSV exports to your WordPress posts and pages. It works seamlessly with popular SEO plugins including Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, and The SEO Framework.

Key Features

  • Multi-Plugin Support: Works with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, and The SEO Framework
  • CSV Import: Upload CSV files from Rankioz with suggested meta titles and descriptions
  • Dry Run Mode: Preview changes before applying them to your site
  • Batch Processing: Process large datasets efficiently with configurable batch sizes
  • Backup & Rollback: Automatic backup of existing values with easy rollback functionality
  • Error Handling: Comprehensive error reporting with downloadable error logs
  • WP-CLI Support: Command-line interface for advanced users
  • Security First: Proper nonce verification, capability checks, and input sanitization
  • AJAX Interface: Modern, responsive admin interface with real-time progress updates

How It Works

  1. Export your SEO analysis from Rankioz as a CSV file
  2. Upload the CSV through the WordPress admin interface
  3. Preview the suggested changes in dry-run mode
  4. Apply the fixes with confidence, knowing you can rollback if needed
  5. Download error reports for any issues encountered

Supported SEO Plugins

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math
  • All in One SEO
  • SEOPress
  • The SEO Framework
  • WordPress Core (fallback for sites without SEO plugins)

CSV Format

Your CSV file should include the following columns:
* url – The URL of the page/post
* meta_title_suggested – The suggested meta title
* meta_desc_suggested – The suggested meta description

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • One of the supported SEO plugins (optional – plugin works with WordPress core as fallback)

Support

For support, please visit https://rankioz.com/support or contact us through our website.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All processing is done locally on your WordPress installation. CSV files are temporarily stored in WordPress transients and are automatically cleaned up after processing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rankioz-seo directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Tools > Rankioz SEO in your WordPress admin
  4. Upload your CSV file from Rankioz and start optimizing your SEO!
sections.faq:
What SEO plugins are supported?

The plugin supports Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, and The SEO Framework. If none of these plugins are active, it will fall back to WordPress core meta handling.

What CSV format is required?

Your CSV should have columns named: url, meta_title_suggested, and meta_desc_suggested.

Is it safe to use on production sites?

Yes! The plugin includes a dry-run mode that lets you preview all changes before applying them. It also creates automatic backups that you can restore from if needed.

What if something goes wrong?

The plugin includes comprehensive error logging and a rollback feature that restores your original meta titles and descriptions from automatic backups.

Can I process large CSV files?

Yes! The plugin processes files in configurable batches to handle large datasets efficiently without overwhelming your server.

Do I need a Rankioz account?

Yes, you need a Rankioz account to generate the CSV files that this plugin processes.
